design_decisions.decision: Absolute asset URLs (/leaflet.js) since the page is served at /; rejected relative paths.
Stop dots use a fixed dark outline "#222" in map.js with route-colored fill; rejected a style.css rule so style.css holds no color tied to routes.
Marker images copied to web/images/ (leaflet.css expects images/ next to it); LICENSE kept as web/LICENSE.
Initial setView on Angeles City, replaced by fitBounds on success; rejected leaving map unset so banner cases still show a map.

implementation.self_critique: Browser behavior (criteria 5-14) is unverified, and pytest could not run against a DB, so the edited static test is unexecuted. leaflet.js carries a sourceMappingURL comment to a map file not vendored (devtools-only 404).
